executionMode: pg-mem (in-memory Postgres emulator — NOT real PostgreSQL; no query planner, no index scans modelled)
leaderboardSqlNotRunnableInPgMem: EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (timestamptz - timestamptz)) throws "operator does not exist" in pg-mem; SQL-leaderboard equality must be checked on real PostgreSQL (see REPORT.md).
note: pg-mem timings measure JS-emulator overhead, not database performance. Real EXPLAIN ANALYZE before/after numbers require PostgreSQL; see REPORT.md for the exact commands.
